events.title: Fireweed and Yukon Peaks
events.thought: Fireweed in August means summer is turning — and the mountains don't care.
events.photoCaption: Fireweed in full bloom frames snow-capped Yukon peaks, summer's last hurrah before the alpine turns gold.
